d: The CSI Team works against a ticking clock to find the purported accomplice in a years-old ax-murder case before the convicted killer is executed.
The CSI team races against time to locate and deactivate a radioactive bomb set to go off in the middle of downtown Miami.
Horatio and the CSI team face off with Miami’s notorious and deadly Mala Noche gang after a funeral becomes the scene of a murder.
A family boating accident reveals a sinister plot by grifters to heist 10 million dollars in gold bars.  Horatio and the CSI team investigate.
The team investigates the murder of a teenage girl partying in Miami on her way to the Bahamas with her high school class.
A young man faces life in prison – and possibly worse – unless Horatio can prove his innocence against insurmountable odds.
Horatio and the team race against time to find out who is trying to frame Horatio for the murder of a woman he’s been dating.
When a "wives weekend" ends in murder, the CSI team is faced with three women whose separate trysts with the victim make them prime suspects
The team works in tandem with NY CSI chief Mac Taylor to apprehend a serial killer before he kills the young girl he has just taken hostage
Ryan Wolfe is attacked and seriously injured while investigating the murder of a distraught soon-to-be ex-wife, and there is no shortage of suspects.
Horatio and the CSI team must rely on a video game for their next clue as to where a group of young gunmen will strike next.
The CSI team is hard-pressed to find the killer of an infamous drug lord, and a member of the team is investigated for drugs by Internal Affairs.
A rapist is brutally murdered after his identity is exposed.  Horatio and the CSI team are called in to investigate the murder.
Horatio and the CSI team investigate a group of male “pickup artists” out to score when one of them unexpectedly turns up dead.
Miami’s Latin Festival shifts from Samba to somber when a crowded dance floor becomes the scene of a gang member.  Horatio and the team investigate.
A bizarre murder of a South Beach club owner turns out to be a script where art is imitating life.  Horatio and the CSI team investigate.
Horatio’s longtime criminal nemesis Walter Resden surfaces once again, and Caine is determined to finally bring him to justice.
